actNarration: Two scrying-objects land at V5 = Protection + Memory. The Transmutation (Part 1, Bitcoin-anchored) and The Boundary Blade (Part 2) — both controlled by flaxscrip. Documents become first-class lattice citizens. The system now contains its own narrative as data. The cloak's recursion closes: the chronicle that describes the Transmutation is registered inside the Spell Weaver that is performing the Transmutation.

items.label: The Transmutation
items.notes: Sovereign Anchor Series — Part 1. Anchored to Bitcoin mainnet at publication. Describes the One-Way Valve: Archon Root → Swordsman/Mage Dual Agent → Z/(2⁶)Z lattice projection → Sovereign Proof. The chronicle of the process this rebuild is performing.
items.poeticOverlay:
What was once intangible now has a blade-address.
The asset does not exist in a vault.
It exists in the lattice, where authorship is proven, not possessed.
The stone remembers what the storyteller might forget.

items.label: The Boundary Blade
items.notes: Sovereign Anchor Series — Part 2. The chronicle of active enforcement: 7-node VC decomposition, NIZK issuer authority (V17), the One-Way Valve as selective disclosure protocol. Establishes the blueprint we will execute in Act 7.
items.poeticOverlay:
The blade does not cut to harm.
It cuts to make the boundary visible —
between what may be revealed,
what must be masked,
and what is proven without being seen.
